sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, current leaders with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in commanding position atop the table and face an Alsager side firmly rooted at the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games. This should present a favorable opportunity for the league leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to keep pace with Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) face Eccleshall (5th) in an intriguing mid-table clash, while in-form Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, unbeaten in their last three) entertain Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir in a battle of the mid-table fringe, and Barnton (7th) visit Shawbury United (15th), who are enduring a dire run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town and New Mills meet in a fixture between two mid-table sides, while bottom-dweller Widnes Town travel to face Brereton Social (14th). Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town (19th) in a clash between two of the division's weakest-performing sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday, and midweek on Wednesday, Brereton Social entertain Wednesfield Community in an evening fixture.
